outcome: Maternal serum Slit guidance ligand 2 protein (Slit2-C) levels
cohort: The study included two groups of pregnant women: 58 with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) and 58 with normal glucose tolerance (NGT).
finding: Maternal Slit2-C and NRG4 levels were significantly lower in the GDM group, while cord serum C-peptide levels were increased, and a negative correlation was observed between maternal batokines and cord C-peptide.
cross-section timing: On the day of cesarean section
